source_title: NHDOT OS/OW Permits — N.H. Code Admin. Rules Tra 304 (escorts: Tra 304.17)

superload_thresholds.note: NH superload = over 16' wide, over 16' high, over 110' long, or over 160,000 lbs gross. Routine (non-superload) permit envelope: 16' wide, 16' high, 110' long; single axle 25,000 / tandem 50,000 / tridem 70,000 / quad 85,000 lbs. Loads over 110' long and/or over 13'6" high require a route survey.

width.note: 1 non-police escort for width 12'0" to under 14'0" (Tra 304.17)
width over 14'0": 2 state police escorts required (Tra 304.17)

height.note: 1 non-police escort for height over 14'0"; route survey required over 13'6" (Tra 304.17)

length.note: 1 non-police escort at 90'0" or greater overall length (Tra 304.17)
length 100'0" or more: 1 state police escort in addition to the non-police escort (Tra 304.17)

single_trip.fee_formula: Single-trip OS/OW permit = $115 statewide, or $60 within a 100-mile radius if the vehicle is based and registered in NH. Superload/route-survey moves may incur additional review fees.
single_trip.note: Single-trip permit valid 5 travel days. Also 2nd non-police escort required when a rear overhang of 15'+ combines with width 12'+; a 3rd state police escort applies where a highway closure is required (Tra 304.17).

annual.note: Annual statewide permit $115 for vehicles within 75' length, 10'6" width, 13'6" height and NH legal registered GVW.

movement_restrictions: Movement restricted to daylight hours, one-half hour before sunrise to one-half hour after sunset
Monday through Friday only; no weekend or holiday travel for over-dimensional loads
Permits void during slippery pavement / inclement weather (fog, haze, heavy rain, freezing rain, snow)
Escort drivers must maintain visual and two-way radio contact with the permitted vehicle at all times
notes: Legal limits: width 8'6", height 13'6", gross 80,000 lbs; 53' semitrailer on the National Network.
Escort matrix read from N.H. Code Admin. Rules Tra 304.17 (Escort Vehicles); superload envelope and permit fees from NHDOT OS/OW permit rules (nhdotpermits.org).
